description: a boss of radius R and height H whose top rim is chamfered at d — a 45° cone from r = R at z = H − d to r = R − d at z = H — and then, in a second operation, a slot 2w wide cut across its top from z = zc up: the closure ADR-0020 is about, a body Arris made taken back as a boolean operand. The slot's walls x = ±w are parallel to the cone's axis and meet it in exact hyperbolas; its floor z = zc meets it in a circle of radius R − (zc − H + d). Both carry a fitted pcurve on the chamfer cone. The chamfer's own volume is the triangle d²/2 swept about the axis at R − d/3 by Pappus; what the slot takes off the cone and the top face wants asin over the recipe grammar, so the oracle holds the volume
